package.description: AI-powered smart commit message generator with multi-provider fallback

en-US.description: AI-powered smart commit message generator with multi-provider fallback
en-US.longDescription:
git-sc writes commit messages from your staged changes using AI coding agent CLIs,
falling back across providers automatically when one is unavailable or rate-limited.
It detects the commit format from recent history, supports amend, squash and reword,
and can exclude paths from the diff it sends.
en-US.name: git-sc
